newsitem.title: USA: B.A.T unit says gets favorable ruling.
newsitem.headline: B.A.T unit says gets favorable ruling.

text.p: Brown & Williamson, a unit of B.A.T. Industries Plc, said Thursday that a lawsuit filed against it and on behalf of a former smoker has been blocked from moving forward.
The company said U.S. District Court Judge Richard Haik in Louisiana accepted its motion for summary judgment, ruling the lawsuit would not go any further.
The case had been scheduled to go to trial in January 1997.
Brown & Williamson said its motion for summary judgment cited several recent cases in which courts have held that the public has long been aware of risks associated with smoking.
